claims.content: To maintain Distributor records by adding new records, editing available records, deleting records only when no child records are created, viewing Sales History, and setting Active/Deactivate status.

goal.raw_text: To maintain Distributor records by adding new records, editing available records, deleting records only when no child records are created, viewing Sales History, and setting Active/Deactivate status.

claims.content: VMU User
When a VMU User selects an option on the distributor screen to add, edit, delete, view Sales History, or activate/deactivate a distributor record.

trigger.raw_text: When a VMU User selects an option on the distributor screen to add, edit, delete, view Sales History, or activate/deactivate a distributor record.

claims.content: Following fields will be captured at this master: Distributor Code (3 Digit) Example: DS0001, Name of the distributor, Type of business (e.g. hospital/pharmacy/NGO), Proprietor Name, Designation, Address (Street/Road, Sub District, County, Sub County and Village or Town), Contact No, Email Id, Status (active/deactivate).
At the distributor screen, if the VMU User selects Edit, the option is for updating available records.
At the distributor screen, if the VMU User selects Delete, deleting will be allowed only if no child records are created.

At the distributor screen, there will be a provision to select a particular distributor to view the details (e.g. sales) by double clicking on the grid; the Sales History of a particular distributor will show Distributor Name as Report Header and Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, and Balance Qty as the report footer.
Print option of the Sales History report is based on User Login Permission only.
If child records have been created for the distributor, Delete is not allowed; the distributor record is not deleted and the use case exits without performing deletion.

The distributor master record contains Distributor Code (3 Digit) Example: DS0001, Name of the distributor, Type of business (e.g. hospital/pharmacy/NGO), Proprietor Name, Designation, Address (Street/Road, Sub District, County, Sub County and Village or Town), Contact No, Email Id, Status (active/deactivate).
Each distributor has a unique code and detailed descriptions such as name, address, locations and type of business, so the users can get the details of any distributor and sales details at any time.
If New is selected, a new distributor record is added.
If Edit is selected, an available distributor record is updated.
For a successful Delete, no child records have been created for that distributor.

If a particular distributor is selected to view details, the Sales History summary is shown with Distributor Name as Report Header and Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, and Balance Qty as the report footer.
The Print option of the Sales History report is based on User Login Permission only.
The distributor record has a Status of active/deactivate, and Active/Deactivate is used if the distributor has to be deactivated or terminated.
Other users have a provision to view the details of a distributor with purchase and sales details.
